title: Protocol Specifications
blurb: The open standards agents use to talk to tools, to each other and to people: A2A, MCP, ANP, Agent Client Protocol, AG-UI and their neighbors.

title: Agent Payments and Commerce
blurb: Protocols that let agents pay, get paid and complete purchases on behalf of users.

title: Discovery, Identity and Registries
blurb: Agent cards, schemas, directories, identity and trust layers that let one agent find and verify another.

title: MCP Gateways and Proxies
blurb: Gateways, aggregators and transport bridges that put many MCP servers behind one governed endpoint.

title: Orchestration Frameworks
blurb: Frameworks and platforms for composing multiple agents into working systems.

title: Protocol SDKs
blurb: Official and widely used client and server libraries for A2A and MCP in many languages.

title: Developer Tools and Bridges
blurb: Inspectors, conformance suites, samples and bridges for building and testing interoperable agents.

title: Directories and Curated Lists
blurb: Places to browse and discover servers, agents and protocol resources.
